verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce publishes public REST API docs with concrete endpoints: POST /acp/v1/tokens for card enrollment, POST /acp/v1/instructions for purchase intents with mandates and cancellation, and POST /acp/v1/instructions/{id}/credentials for credential retrieval. These come with production and test hosts, a self-serve sandbox signup, an llms.txt, and an official MCP/agent toolkit; probes confirm the API gateway is live and credential-gated as documented and the MCP package resolves on npm. Missing for 10: no hands-on evidence of a successful call to the Intelligent Commerce endpoints, production access is not self-serve ("Contact Visa for fees in Production"), and the docs carry a "in the process of development and deployment" maturity caveat.
